title: Grammar: Prepositions — Time, Place, and Movement
grammarTip:
Предлоги в контексте путешествий и передвижения:

Предлоги МЕСТА:
at → конкретная точка: at the station · at the airport · at the hotel
in → внутри пространства: in the city · in the country · in the building
on → на поверхности: on the plane · on the bus · on the street

Предлоги ТРАНСПОРТА:
by + транспорт (без артикля): by bus · by train · by plane · by taxi · on foot
in + личный транспорт: in the car · in a taxi
on + общественный: on the bus · on the train · on the plane

Предлоги ВРЕМЕНИ в путешествиях:
at: at 9 o'clock · at noon · at night
on: on Monday · on 15th July · on arrival
in: in January · in 2025 · in the morning

💡 Главная ловушка: "by taxi" (без артикля!) но "in a/the taxi" (с артиклем!)

grammarExtra.title: AT, IN, ON for Time — Advanced Use

rows.form: AT: exact times, specific points, holidays
rows.example: "at 9am", "at the weekend" (BrE), "at Christmas", "at midnight", "at the same time"

rows.form: IN: months, years, seasons, parts of day
rows.example: "in January", "in 2025", "in summer", "in the morning/afternoon/evening"

rows.form: ON: days, dates, specific occasions
rows.example: "on Monday", "on 12th March", "on my birthday", "on a rainy day", "on arrival"

rows.form: No preposition: last/next/this/every + time
rows.example: "last Monday", "next week", "this morning", "every summer" — no preposition!

grammarExtra.title: AT, IN, ON for Place — Advanced Use

rows.form: AT: specific locations / events
rows.example: "at the airport", "at the border", "at a conference", "at the coast", "at home"

rows.form: IN: enclosed spaces, cities, countries, regions
rows.example: "in the hotel", "in Almaty", "in Kazakhstan", "in the south", "in the mountains"

rows.form: ON: surfaces, roads, transport, islands
rows.example: "on the beach", "on the road", "on a ship", "on the island", "on the first floor"

rows.form: Special cases to memorise
rows.example: "in the sky" / "on the plane" / "at the airport" / "in a taxi" / "on a bus/train"

grammarExtra.title: Movement Prepositions: Through, Across, Along, Past, Into, Onto

rows.form: through = from one side to the other (inside)
rows.example: "We drove through the tunnel." "She walked through the crowd."

rows.form: across = from one side to the other (surface or open space)
rows.example: "We sailed across the lake." "She walked across the bridge."

rows.form: along = following the length of something
rows.example: "We walked along the river." "They drove along the coast."

rows.form: past = going beyond a point without stopping
rows.example: "Turn left just past the museum." "The bus goes past the station."

rows.form: into = entering an enclosed space
rows.example: "She walked into the hotel." "He drove into the city."

rows.form: onto = movement onto a surface / on top
rows.example: "She stepped onto the boat." "He climbed onto the roof."

rows.form: by + transport (no article): how you travel
rows.example: "by car", "by train", "by plane", "by bus", "by ferry", "by foot" / "on foot" (both used)

rows.form: by + time: before or not later than
rows.example: "We must arrive by 9am." "The visa must be approved by Friday."

rows.form: "By the time" + clause: when something is completed
rows.example: "By the time we arrived, the museum had closed."

grammarExtra.title: Common Preposition Errors in Travel Contexts

rows.form: ❌ We arrived to the airport at noon.
rows.example: ✅ We arrived at the airport at noon. ("arrive at" a place)

rows.form: ❌ She travelled by the plane.
rows.example: ✅ She travelled by plane. (no article after "by + transport")

rows.form: ❌ I will go there on next Monday.
rows.example: ✅ I will go there next Monday. (no preposition with next/last/this)

rows.form: ❌ We walked along the tunnel.
rows.example: ✅ We walked through the tunnel. ("through" = enclosed space, end to end)

exercises.text: "She arrived ___ the airport ___ 6am ___ a cold morning."
exercises.hint: "Arrive at" the airport; "at 6am" (exact time); "on a cold morning"

exercises.text: "He travelled ___ train from Almaty to Astana and arrived ___ 3pm."
"The road goes ___ the mountains, not over them — it's a long tunnel."
"We walked ___ the canal for about two hours before stopping ___ a small café."
exercises.hint: "Along" = following the length of something; "at" a specific place

exercises.text: "She has been living ___ Seoul ___ three years — she arrived ___ the spring."
"We will travel by the car to the border and then cross on foot."
"The ferry sails ___ the island every morning at 8am and docks ___ the main harbour."
exercises.hint: "Sail to" a destination; "dock at" a specific place

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct preposition for movement.
exercises.text: "She stepped carefully ___ the small boat and found a seat ___ the bow."
exercises.hint: "Step onto" a surface; "at the bow" (specific location)

exercises.text: "I saw her ___ last Tuesday — she was just back from her trip." (last Tuesday = ?)
exercises.hint: Days: "on Tuesday" but "last Tuesday" usually has no preposition in spoken English — both exist

exercises.text: "The hiking trail goes ___ the forest and then ___ a river."
"We must be ___ the hotel ___ noon — check-out is ___ 12pm sharp."

opts: She lives on France for six months every year.
She lives in France for six months every year.
She lives at France for six months every year.
She lives for France six months every year.
exercises.correct: She lives in France for six months every year.

exercises.text: "Drive ___ the market and continue until you pass ___ the old city gate."
exercises.hint: "Past" = go beyond without entering; "through" = enter one side, exit the other

exercises.text: "She was born ___ the 15th of March ___ a small village ___ the north."
exercises.hint: "On" a date; "in" a village; "in the north" (region)

exercises.text: "By the time we got ___ the summit, we had been walking ___ six hours."
exercises.hint: "Get to" the summit (arrive at); "for six hours" (duration)

questions.text: "She arrived ___ the station ___ a rainy evening ___ October."
questions.hint: "Arrive at" the station; "on a rainy evening"; "in October"

questions.text: "He drove ___ the city, turned right just ___ the museum, and parked ___ the square."
"We travelled ___ bus and arrived ___ the border ___ midnight."
"The path runs ___ the lake — you can walk ___ it for about three kilometres."
"___ the time they reached the hotel, it was already dark and they hadn't eaten ___ hours."
"We will arrive to the airport by noon" is grammatically correct.
"She stepped carefully ___ the boat and found a seat near the front."
"I am going there ___ next week — no need to book far in advance."
"The train passes ___ three countries before reaching its final destination."
questions.hint: "Through" countries = passing from one side to the other (enclosed political space)

questions.text: "He was born ___ April 3rd ___ a small town ___ the south of France."
questions.hint: "On" a date; "in" a town; "in the south"

questions.text: "They sailed ___ the strait in just two hours." (from one side to the other — open water)
questions.hint: "Across" = from one side to the other (open water)

questions.text: "She travelled ___ plane to Bangkok and then took a bus ___ the city centre."
